How to create an App Password
Google requires using a 16-character ’App Password’ to send messages securely via SMTP without sharing your main account password.
Make sure (2-Step Verification) is enabled on your Google account.
Go to the App Passwords page in your Google account security settings.
Enter an app name (for example, Phone Protection), then select Create.
Copy the code into the app
Copy the 16-character yellow code and paste it into the app’s password field.
Go to the Google App Passwords page
Create a 6 to 8 digit PIN to protect the app settings. The app does not store the PIN itself, it stores a secure fingerprint of it.
Enter the PIN to access protection, picture, and location settings.
The new PIN must be 6 to 8 digits long
